sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head brown; antennae, postclypeus, area around the fontanelle and legs rusty yellow; pronotum brown, with a yellow shoulder spot on each side and a T-shaped mark at the middle, preceded by a small triangular spot; wings brown with reddish brown stripes; abdomen greyish brown to rusty brown, anterior sternites nearly white at the middle. Head and body with moderately dense rusty yellow hairs. Body length 26.5 mm, 11.00 mm without wings. Head broadly oval, 2.28 mm long, 2.09 mm wide. Fontanelle not raised, circular, open, nearly white. Compound eyes medium-sized, normally projecting. Ocelli medium-sized, separated from the compound eye by about half its diameter. Antennae 19-segmented; segment 2 equal to segments 3 and 4 together; segment 4 longer than segment 3 and equal to segment 5. Postclypeus weakly inflated, much less than half as long as wide. Pronotum as wide as the head excluding eyes, semicircular; 1.10 mm long, 1.90 mm wide; anterior angles strongly rounded; anterior margin concave at the middle; posterior margin weakly concave. Mesonotal posterior margin with an acutely angled notch, metanotal notch broad and angular. Fore wing 22.0 mm long.
